title: Nightscout uploader bug with multiple insulin profiles
body:
Hi! In setting i choosed Fiasp as short, and lantus as long, in xdrip it shows correctly, but prediction line for lantus has 4-6 hours for lantus, but it works all 24 hours.
And then all data uploaded in my nightscout, and it shows basal lantus doses as fast bolus insuline.

How i can fix these issues, or it need to be updated in code?

### Your environment
xdrip version is4f493d3f9-2022.02.17, code 2022021722
nightscout is latest stable version
